functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_confirmed_sale_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if old.order_status <> 'draft' and (
    new.company_id is distinct from old.company_id or new.customer_id is distinct from old.customer_id or
    new.scheduled_for is distinct from old.scheduled_for or new.subtotal is distinct from old.subtotal or
    new.discount_total is distinct from old.discount_total or new.total_amount is distinct from old.total_amount or
    new.estimated_cogs is distinct from old.estimated_cogs or new.delivery_address_snapshot is distinct from old.delivery_address_snapshot or
    new.apartment_snapshot is distinct from old.apartment_snapshot or new.notes is distinct from old.notes
  ) then raise exception using message = 'CONFIRMED_SALE_IMMUTABLE'; end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_received_purchase_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if old.status = 'received' and (
    new.supplier_id is distinct from old.supplier_id or
    new.company_id is distinct from old.company_id or
    new.purchase_date is distinct from old.purchase_date or
    new.received_at is distinct from old.received_at or
    new.received_by is distinct from old.received_by or
    new.status is distinct from old.status or
    new.notes is distinct from old.notes or
    new.subtotal is distinct from old.subtotal or
    new.additional_costs is distinct from old.additional_costs or
    new.discount is distinct from old.discount or
    new.total_amount is distinct from old.total_amount or
    new.created_by is distinct from old.created_by
  ) then
    raise exception using message = 'RECEIVED_PURCHASE_IMMUTABLE';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recalculate_purchase_totals()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  purchase_id_value uuid := coalesce(new.purchase_id, old.purchase_id);
begin
  update public.purchases p
  set subtotal = coalesce((select sum(total_cost) from public.purchase_items where purchase_id = purchase_id_value), 0),
      total_amount = greatest(coalesce((select sum(total_cost) from public.purchase_items where purchase_id = purchase_id_value), 0) + p.additional_costs - p.discount, 0),
      updated_at = timezone('utc', now())
  where p.id = purchase_id_value;
  return coalesce(new, old);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_sale_status_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if old.order_status is distinct from new.order_status or old.fulfillment_status is distinct from new.fulfillment_status or old.payment_status is distinct from new.payment_status then
    insert into public.sale_status_history(sale_id, order_status, fulfillment_status, payment_status, reason, changed_by)
    values (new.id, new.order_status, new.fulfillment_status, new.payment_status, null, (select auth.uid()));
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
